declarations.name: AuiDataGrid

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the grid.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Accessible description of the grid (aria-describedby).

inputs.name: columns
inputs.description: Columns and column groups (nested). Column: id, header, accessor or field, type, currency, format, render, align, width, minWidth, maxWidth, flex, resizable, movable, pinned, lockPinned, lockPosition, hidden, sortable, compare, headerTooltip, wrapHeader, wrapText, rowDrag (this column holds the row drag handle; default the first data column), tooltip (true, a text, or (value, row) => text; with the tooltips accessory), spanRows (true or (a, b) => boolean: merge equal adjacent values), colSpan (row => columns covered), cellClass, cellClassRules, flashOnChange, copyValue, exportable, formula (a calculated column with the formulas option: [Column] is the same row, A1 references and functions as in spreadsheets; read-only), formulas (cell formulas: values that are text starting with = are evaluated; editing shows the formula; fill, Ctrl+D, and paste of copied cells move relative A1 references), excel (Excel export: style, cellStyle(row), numberFormat, formula(row, ref), link(row), image(row), width) (false leaves the column out of CSV and Excel exports of visible or all columns), aggregate, showAs, groupable, groupHierarchy, editable, setValue, parseValue, editor, required, validate, filter, filterValue, filterCaseSensitive, filterAccentSensitive, filterValues, businessCalendar, searchable, visibleWhen. Group: id, header, children, collapsible, collapsed, headerTooltip.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: Row data (never mutated).

inputs.name: rowId
inputs.description: Stable, unique, non-empty id per row.

inputs.name: rowHeight
inputs.description: Row height in pixels (16 to 1000), or a function of the row. Default by density: 32, 40, or 48.

inputs.name: autoRowHeight
inputs.description: Measure rendered rows and let them grow to their content (with wrapText columns); the scroll position stays anchored.

inputs.name: layout
inputs.description: fill: fills the host (which needs a height). auto: grows with its rows up to the host max-block-size.

inputs.name: pageSizes
inputs.description: Offer a "Rows per page" choice with these sizes.

inputs.name: externalFilter
inputs.description: Application filter applied with the others; call refreshFilters() when its result may change.

inputs.name: floatingFilters
inputs.description: A header row of compact filter controls under the column headers: text contains, number syntax (5, >5, <=10, !=0, 5..10), date, boolean choice, set summary; complex filters show a read-only summary.

inputs.name: searchBox
inputs.description: A search box above the grid (role search) that sets the quick filter as the user types.

inputs.name: advancedFilter
inputs.description: An expression bar with type-ahead suggestions and a builder dialog replaces the column filter UI; column filters stop applying while it is on.

inputs.name: rowSelection
inputs.description: Row selection: { mode: 'single' | 'multiple', checkboxes (default true; a checkbox column pinned first), headerCheckbox (default true), selectAll: 'filtered' (default) | 'all' | 'page', clickToSelect (default false), selectable(row) }.

inputs.name: cellSelection
inputs.description: Cell ranges: drag, Ctrl+drag adds, Shift+click and Shift+arrows extend, Ctrl+A selects all; { multiple (default true), columnSelection (header Enter or click selects the column; sorting moves to Alt), fillHandle (drag the corner to fill a series; Alt repeats or counts; double-click fills down) }.

inputs.name: copyHeaders
inputs.description: Copy column headers above copied cells.

inputs.name: readOnlyEdits
inputs.description: Writes (paste, cut, Delete, fill, edits) are only requested: aui-cells-change reports them with applied: false and the application applies them.

inputs.name: clickToEdit
inputs.description: A single click on an editable cell starts editing (otherwise Enter, F2, typing, Backspace, or a double-click).

inputs.name: enterMovesDown
inputs.description: Enter commits an edit and moves to the cell below.

inputs.name: invalidEdit
inputs.description: An invalid edit keeps the editor open with an announced message (block), or is discarded (revert). Focus leaving the editor discards an invalid value.

inputs.name: undoLimit
inputs.description: Undo steps kept for edits, paste, cut, Delete, fill, and bulk edit (0 turns undo off); cleared when the application replaces or updates rows.

inputs.name: editMode
inputs.description: row: editing opens every editable cell of the row; Tab moves within it; Enter commits the row as one write and one undo step.

inputs.name: validateRow
inputs.type: ((values: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>, row: Row) => string | Readonly<Record<string, string>> | null)
inputs.description: Row mode: cross-field validation; a message (or messages by column) blocks the commit.

inputs.name: groupDefaultExpanded
inputs.description: Levels expanded by default (0: all collapsed; -1: all expanded).

inputs.name: groupTotals
inputs.description: A total row after each expanded group.

inputs.name: grandTotal
inputs.description: A grand total row at the top or bottom of the rows, or pinned above or below them (pinnedTop, pinnedBottom); flat grids too.

inputs.name: groupDisplay
inputs.description: One generated group column indented by level, one per level (named after the grouped column; date parts in parentheses), or rows: group rows drawn as one cell across the row (no group column; not for tree data or pivot mode).

inputs.name: stickyGroupRows
inputs.description: While grouped, the group rows of the topmost row stay under the header as their groups scroll (copies hidden from assistive technology; their toggles work).

inputs.name: fullWidthRow
inputs.type: { isFullWidth: (row: Row) => boolean; render: (row: Row, context: { readonly doc: Document; readonly rowId: string; }) => Node; } | null
inputs.description: Rows drawn as one cell across every column (it stays in view while the rows scroll sideways); never edited, filled, or part of ranges.

inputs.name: groupColumn
inputs.description: Header text and width of the generated group column.

inputs.name: hideGroupedColumns
inputs.description: Hide grouped columns while grouped.

inputs.name: expanded
inputs.description: Group rows expanded or collapsed explicitly, by group id.

inputs.name: groupPanel
inputs.description: A panel above the grid lists the row groups: move earlier, move later, remove, add a groupable column; dropping a groupable header on it groups by that column; pills can be dragged to reorder, or out of the panel to remove (the buttons are the keyboard path).

inputs.name: aggregateFilteredOnly
inputs.description: Aggregates use only the rows that pass the filters; false aggregates every row of each group.

inputs.name: accessories
inputs.description: Accessories from @absoluteui/components/data-grid/accessories: columnMenu(), contextMenu(), columnChooser() (built on Context Menu and Dialog, outside the core bundle). The grid must be in the document when they attach.

inputs.name: headerNames
inputs.description: Header names set by the user, by column or column group id (part of the columns state as headers).

inputs.name: pinnedTopRows
inputs.description: Rows always shown above the body in a section named "Pinned to top" (never sorted, filtered, grouped, selected, or edited; at most 1000).

inputs.name: pinnedBottomRows
inputs.description: Rows always shown below the body in a section named "Pinned to bottom".

inputs.name: pinned
inputs.description: Rows pinned to the top or bottom by id (they also stay in the body; filters hide the pinned copy).

inputs.name: formulas
inputs.description: The formula engine for calculated columns: formulaEngine({ functions?, calendar? }) from @absoluteui/components/data-grid/formulas (our own parser and evaluator; no eval). Results recalculate when rows change; errors show their code (#DIV/0!, #REF!, ...) with the meaning read out.

inputs.name: fileDrop
inputs.description: Files dropped on the grid: an overlay (aui-data-grid__file-drop, default text "Drop files to load") shows while files are over it; files matching accept (extensions such as .csv, MIME types such as text/csv or text/*; default all) go to onFiles, others are announced. Pointer only: offer a file input too. With parseCsv from @absoluteui/helpers/csv, coerceCsvValues, and inferColumns an app can load a dropped CSV with generated columns.

inputs.name: rowDragging
inputs.description: Row dragging: a drag handle in the rowDrag column (pointer: a drop line, or a target row in parent-id tree data), and Ctrl+Shift+ArrowUp / ArrowDown on a handle cell (in trees Ctrl+Shift+ArrowRight / ArrowLeft indent and outdent); announced. managed: the grid moves the rows (one undo step) while not sorted, filtered, grouped, pivoted, or server-side; multiRow: dragging a selected row drags every selected row; canDrag limits the rows. nativeData: the handle uses native drag and drop and the drag carries that data (MIME type to text) to other apps; drops on the rows and on zones work as with the pointer. Drop zones: addRowDropZone, rowDropZone.

inputs.name: rowNumbers
inputs.description: A leading column numbering the rows by display position (width 32 to 200, default 56); with cell ranges a click on a number selects the row's cells; resizable adds a handle (drag, or Alt+ArrowUp / Alt+ArrowDown on the number) that sets the row's height.

inputs.name: datasource
inputs.description: Server row model: { getRows(request, signal) => Promise<{ rows, rowCount? }> } (request: start, end, sort, filters, quickFilter, advancedFilter, groupBy, groupKeys); with groupBy the top level loads group rows and each expanded group loads its own rows; rows load in blocks as they scroll into view, and sort, filters, the quick filter, and the advanced filter run on the server (rows is ignored; pass []). An unknown rowCount grows block by block until a short block.

inputs.name: blockSize
inputs.description: Rows per datasource request (1 to 10000).

inputs.name: maxBlocks
inputs.description: Loaded blocks kept; the least recently used are released (null keeps all).

inputs.name: blockLoadDelay
inputs.description: Milliseconds to wait before loading while scrolling (0 to 5000).

inputs.name: maxConcurrentLoads
inputs.description: Datasource requests at a time (1 to 20).

inputs.name: initialRowCount
inputs.description: Rows assumed before the first answer (the scrollbar size).

inputs.name: getChildCount
inputs.description: Server groups: the number of rows below a group row (shown with its key); null when unknown.

inputs.name: purgeClosedGroups
inputs.description: Server groups: collapsing a group releases its loaded rows (they load again when it expands).

inputs.name: pivotPanel
inputs.description: A panel above the grid edits the pivot: rows, columns, and values zones with pills (move, remove; an aggregate per value) and pickers; pills can be dragged within and between zones (a value keeps its aggregate, a new value gets sum or count) or out of the panel to remove.

inputs.name: pivotMaxColumns
inputs.description: Most generated pivot result columns (1 to 100000); more are left out, announced, and reported by getPivotTruncation().

inputs.name: detail
inputs.description: Master/detail: { render(row, { doc, rowId }) => Node, height (px, default 300, or auto), isMaster(row), keep (collapsed details kept, default 10), expandedByDefault, destroy(node, row) }; a generated toggle column expands a detail row under each master row.

inputs.name: treeData
inputs.description: Tree data: exactly one of serverGroup with serverKey (with a datasource: parents load their children from the server when expanded), getPath (row => string[]; missing levels become filler rows), parentIdField (self-referential; missing parents and cycles become root rows), or childrenField (nested rows); label names the column that labels rows in the group column. groupBy is ignored.

inputs.name: treeFilter
inputs.description: Filtering keeps the ancestors of matching rows; subtree also keeps the rows below a matching row.

inputs.name: flashChanges
inputs.description: Highlight cells whose displayed text changes when rows are updated (setRows, transactions); columns can opt in with flashOnChange.

inputs.name: flashDuration
inputs.description: Milliseconds a changed cell stays highlighted (100 to 10000).

inputs.name: rowClassRules
inputs.description: Classes added to a row while their predicate is true (re-evaluated on every render).

inputs.name: loading
inputs.description: Busy state: aria-busy and an announced loading overlay; rows stay in place.

inputs.name: emptyMessage
inputs.description: Text of the single grid cell shown when there are no rows. Default "No rows to show".

inputs.name: multiSort
inputs.description: Shift+click and Shift+Enter add a column to the sort.

inputs.name: sortCycle
inputs.description: tri-state: ascending, descending, unsorted. bi-state: ascending, descending.

inputs.name: overscan
inputs.description: Rows rendered beyond each edge of the viewport (0 to 200).

inputs.name: transactionDelay
inputs.description: Milliseconds between applying queued applyTransactionAsync batches (0 to 10000).

inputs.name: animateRows
inputs.description: Rows glide to their new position after a sort or update (off with reduced motion or animation none).

inputs.name: filterDelay
inputs.description: Milliseconds after typing stops before a typed filter value applies (0 to 10000); Enter applies at once.

inputs.name: maxFilterConditions
inputs.description: Conditions offered per text, number, and date filter in the filter panel (1 to 10).

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Formatting, collation, and messages locale.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: IANA time zone for datetime columns.

inputs.name: density
inputs.description: Row and header heights and cell padding.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Layout direction (pinned sides, arrow keys, resizing mirror).

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon slot overrides (sortAscending, sortDescending, sortNone, expand, collapse, loading, filter, drag).

models.name: sort
models.description: Current sort by priority: { column, direction: "ascending" | "descending" }.

models.name: pageSize
models.description: Rows per page (1 to 1,000,000); null shows every row in one virtualized grid.

models.name: filters
models.description: Active column filters by column id (JSON models: text, number, bigint, date with relative and business ranges, boolean, set). Validated; DATA_GRID_FILTER on malformed models.

models.name: quickFilter
models.description: Rows must contain every word in some searchable visible column (case- and accent-insensitive).

models.name: advancedFilterModel
models.description: The advanced filter: { join, items } of conditions { column, filter } and nested groups. Validated (DATA_GRID_FILTER); conditions on unknown columns are dropped.

models.name: selected
models.description: Selected row ids (unknown and unselectable ids are dropped; kept by id across sort, filter, paging, and updates).

models.name: groupBy
models.description: Group the rows by these columns (in level order). The grid becomes a treegrid with a generated group column (key, count, expansion); grouped columns hide (hideGroupedColumns).

models.name: pivot
models.description: Pivot mode: { rows, columns, values: [{ column, aggregate: sum | count | avg | min | max | distinctCount }] }; rows group by the row fields, a column group per column key holds a result column per value, with total columns; the data columns hide.

outputs.name: rowsChange
outputs.description: A transaction (sync or batched) changed the rows.

outputs.name: filterChange
outputs.description: The user changed a column filter, the quick filter, or the advanced filter; the row count is announced.

outputs.name: columnsChange
outputs.description: The user (or a method) resized, moved, pinned, hid, auto-sized, or fitted columns, or toggled a column group.

outputs.name: cellFocus
outputs.description: Focus moved to another cell or header.

outputs.name: cellActivated
outputs.description: Enter on a cell without widgets, or a double click.

outputs.name: selectionChange
outputs.description: The user changed the row selection ('user', 'select-all'), or selected rows were removed ('rows'); the count is announced for user changes.

outputs.name: rangeChange
outputs.description: The user changed the cell ranges (finished is false while a drag extends the range).

outputs.name: cellsChange
outputs.description: Cells were written by an edit, bulk edit, paste, cut, Delete, fill, undo, or redo (one transaction; with readOnlyEdits only requested, applied: false); rejected lists pasted text a column could not convert.

outputs.name: rowGroupToggled
outputs.description: The user expanded or collapsed a group row (announced with its row count).

outputs.name: groupChange
outputs.description: The user changed the row groups in the group panel (announced).

outputs.name: detailToggle
outputs.description: The user expanded or collapsed a master row's details (announced).

outputs.name: rowPin
outputs.description: The user pinned or unpinned a row (announced).

outputs.name: rowDragStart
outputs.description: The user started dragging rows with a drag handle.

outputs.name: rowDrop
outputs.description: Rows were dropped before, after, or (tree data) inside a target row, by pointer or keyboard; cancel to keep the order. Managed grids then move the rows.

outputs.name: rowResize
outputs.description: The user resized a row with its row number handle (announced).

outputs.name: pivotChanged
outputs.description: The user changed the pivot in the pivot panel (announced).

properties.name: rowCount
properties.description: Read-only: Rows displayed (the current page when paging).

methods.name: setRows
methods.description: Replace the rows; sort, focus, and scroll position are kept.

methods.name: applyTransaction
methods.description: Add, update (by id), and remove (by id) rows; sort is re-applied and rows keep their identity. Emits aui-rows-change; unknown ids are reported in missing.

methods.name: applyTransactionAsync
methods.description: Queue a transaction; queued ones are applied together every transactionDelay ms.

methods.name: flushTransactions
methods.description: Apply queued transactions now.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Active column filters (copies).

methods.name: setFilter
methods.signature: setFilter(column: string, filter: DataGridFilter | null): void
methods.description: Set or clear one column filter (validated; emits nothing).

methods.name: setQuickFilter
methods.description: Set the quick filter text (emits nothing).

methods.name: refreshFilters
methods.description: Re-run the filters (for example after the external filter changed).

methods.name: getAdvancedFilter
methods.description: The advanced filter model (a copy).

methods.name: setAdvancedFilter
methods.description: Set or clear the advanced filter model (validated; emits nothing).

methods.name: getSelected
methods.description: Selected row ids, in source order.

methods.name: getSelectedRows
methods.description: Selected rows, in source order.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Replace the selection (validated; emits nothing).

methods.name: selectAll
methods.description: Select every selectable row in the scope (default: rowSelection.selectAll; emits nothing).

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clear the selection (emits nothing).

methods.name: getCellRanges
methods.description: Cell ranges (copies), the active one last.

methods.name: addCellRange
methods.description: Add a range of displayed rows and visible columns (validated; emits nothing).

methods.name: clearCellRanges
methods.description: Clear the cell ranges (emits nothing).

methods.name: copySelection
methods.description: Copy the ranges, else the selected rows, else the focused cell, with the asynchronous Clipboard API; returns the tab-separated text.

methods.name: startEditing
methods.signature: startEditing(rowId: string, column: string): boolean | undefined
methods.description: Start editing a displayed, editable cell.

methods.name: stopEditing
methods.description: Commit the open edit (an invalid value is discarded) or cancel it.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undo the last applied write or managed row move.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Redo the last undone write.

methods.name: startBatch
methods.description: Collect writes as pending values (shown and spoken as edited; sorting and filtering keep committed data).

methods.name: commitBatch
methods.description: Apply the pending values as one transaction and one undo step (source batch).

methods.name: cancelBatch
methods.description: Discard the pending values.

methods.name: expandAll
methods.description: Expand every group row (emits nothing).

methods.name: collapseAll
methods.description: Collapse every group row (emits nothing).

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.signature: setExpanded(groupId: string, expanded: boolean): boolean | undefined
methods.description: Expand or collapse one group row (emits nothing).

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: The current groups: ids, columns, keys, counts, aggregates, and children.

methods.name: moveRow
methods.signature: moveRow(id: string, parentId: string | null, index: number): boolean | undefined
methods.description: Tree data with parentIdField: move a row under another parent (null: a root) at a position among its new siblings; the row is a shallow copy (never mutated); false for unknown ids, moves into its own subtree, and other tree modes. Emits aui-rows-change.

methods.name: alignWith
methods.description: Keep another grid's columns (order, widths, pinning, visibility, collapsed groups) and horizontal scroll in step with this one, both ways (for example a totals grid under the main grid); the other grid takes this grid's columns now. Returns a function ending it; destroying either grid ends it.

methods.name: addRowDropZone
methods.description: Let rows dragged from this grid drop on an element outside it: { element, label, onDrop, onDragEnter?, onDragMove?, onDragLeave? }, each called with { rowIds, rows, x, y, grid }. The element gets aui-data-grid-drop-zone--active while rows are over it; the cell menu's Send to submenu lists zones by label (the keyboard path, x and y null). Returns a function removing the zone.

methods.name: rowDropZone
methods.signature: rowDropZone(options?: { readonly label?: string; readonly move?: boolean; } | undefined): DataGridRowDropZone<Row> | undefined
methods.description: A zone for another grid's addRowDropZone adding the dropped rows to this grid (at the drop line when its rows are in source order, else at the end; ids already present are skipped); move removes the added rows from the source grid.

methods.name: setColumnHeader
methods.signature: setColumnHeader(id: string, header: string | null): boolean | undefined
methods.description: Rename a column or column group (null restores its defined header); false for unknown ids. Emits aui-columns-change (rename).

methods.name: resetColumns
methods.description: Undo the user's column changes (order, widths, pinning, visibility, collapsed groups, names). Emits aui-columns-change (reset).

methods.name: pinRow
methods.signature: pinRow(rowId: string, side: "bottom" | "top" | null): boolean | undefined
methods.description: Pin a row by id to the top or bottom, or unpin it; false for unknown ids (emits nothing).

methods.name: getPinnedRows
methods.signature: getPinnedRows(): { top: string[]; bottom: string[]; } | undefined
methods.description: Ids of the rows pinned by id, by section, in pin order.

methods.name: setRowHeight
methods.signature: setRowHeight(rowId: string, height: number | null): void
methods.description: Set a row's height in px (16 to 2000), or null for its default height (emits nothing).

methods.name: applyServerTransaction
methods.description: Server row model: apply changes the server already holds to the loaded rows (add at addIndex, update, remove by id; later rows shift; rowCount corrects the total); rows that are not loaded are reported missing. Emits aui-rows-change.

methods.name: getServerSelection
methods.signature: getServerSelection(): { selectAll: boolean; toggled: string[]; } | undefined
methods.description: Server row model: the selection state; with selectAll, toggled lists the rows not selected.

methods.name: setServerSelection
methods.signature: setServerSelection(state: { readonly selectAll: boolean; readonly toggled: readonly string[]; }): void | undefined
methods.description: Server row model: set the selection state (multiple selection only; emits nothing).

methods.name: refresh
methods.signature: refresh(options?: { purge?: boolean; route?: readonly unknown[]; } | undefined): void | undefined
methods.description: Server row model: reload the loaded blocks; purge drops them first (loading rows show).

methods.name: retryLoads
methods.description: Server row model: load failed blocks again (never done automatically).

methods.name: setRowCount
methods.signature: setRowCount(count: number, known?: boolean | undefined): void
methods.description: Server row model: set the row count; known false keeps growing it as blocks arrive.

methods.name: isRowCountKnown
methods.description: Server row model: whether the total row count is known (always true for client rows).

methods.name: getPivot
methods.description: Pivot mode: the current pivot, or null.

methods.name: setPivot
methods.description: Pivot mode: set the pivot; null leaves pivot mode (emits nothing).

methods.name: getPivotTruncation
methods.signature: getPivotTruncation(): { shown: number; total: number; } | null | undefined
methods.description: Pivot mode: result columns shown and in total when pivotMaxColumns left some out, else null.

methods.name: setDetailExpanded
methods.signature: setDetailExpanded(rowId: string, expanded: boolean): boolean | undefined
methods.description: Master/detail: expand or collapse a master row's details; false for rows without details (emits nothing).

methods.name: isDetailExpanded
methods.description: Master/detail: whether a master row's details are expanded.

methods.name: getTreeOrphans
methods.description: Tree data: ids of rows whose parent is missing or would form a cycle (shown as root rows).

methods.name: toCsv
methods.description: RFC 4180 CSV with formula-injection protection (text starting with =, +, -,

methods.name: toCsvBlob
methods.description: toCsv() as a text/csv Blob; downloadCsv from the Data Table entry saves it.

methods.name: cellAddress
methods.signature: cellAddress(rowId: string, column: string): string | null | undefined
methods.description: A cell's stable A1 address for formulas (column letters by column definition order, row numbers by source row order), or null without formula columns.

methods.name: cellFormula
methods.signature: cellFormula(rowId: string, column: string): string | null | undefined
methods.description: A cell's formula: the calculated column's formula or the cell formula; null for plain values.

methods.name: getExportData
methods.description: The rows and columns of an export for exporters such as toXlsx in

methods.name: print
methods.description: Print the rows as a static table shown only in print media (the page itself is hidden while printing): the toCsv row and column choices (columns, rows, groups, pinned), a title (default: the grid label) as the caption, column group headers repeated on every page, group and total rows, the grid direction, and print colors. The table is removed after afterprint. More than 20,000 rows throws DATA_GRID_PRINT (page the grid or export CSV).

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Serializable view state: sort, columns (order, widths, pinned, hidden, collapsed groups), page, page size; includes details (master rows expanded or collapsed), pinnedRows (pinned by id), and pivot.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Restore a view state; untrusted input is validated (DATA_GRID_STATE), unknown ids are dropped; emits nothing.

methods.name: getColumnsState
methods.description: The columns section of the state.

methods.name: moveColumn
methods.signature: moveColumn(id: string, target: string, position?: "before" | "after" | undefined): boolean | undefined
methods.description: Move a column or group next to a sibling with the same parent group.

methods.name: setColumnPinned
methods.signature: setColumnPinned(id: string, pinned: DataGridPinned | null): boolean | undefined
methods.description: Pin to the start or end edge, or unpin.

methods.name: setColumnHidden
methods.signature: setColumnHidden(id: string, hidden: boolean): boolean | undefined
methods.description: Hide or show a column (one always stays visible).

methods.name: autoSizeColumns
methods.description: Size columns to their header and rendered cells.

methods.name: fitColumns
methods.description: Scale the visible columns to the viewport width.

methods.name: focusCell
methods.signature: focusCell(rowId: string, column: string): boolean | undefined
methods.description: Move focus to a cell, scrolling it into view.

methods.name: scrollToRow
methods.description: Scroll a row into view.

methods.name: scrollToColumn
methods.description: Scroll a column into view.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Grid pattern: one tab stop, roving focus between cells and headers, arrow-key navigation, widgets inside cells reached with Enter or F2.

limitations: Pivot mode has no sorting by a result column and no datasource; the server row model does not combine with pivot, master/detail, or client tree data.
Column filters apply live (no Apply button mode yet); advanced filter keywords are English.
Formulas have no NOW(); any row change recalculates formulas lazily for the cells shown; formulas use . for decimals and , between arguments in every locale.
Range charts offer bar, stacked bar, line, area, and pie. PDF export embeds application fonts whole, does not shape Arabic, and is not tagged (the browser print route covers complex scripts).
Pointer resizing, row and pill dragging, and file drop need a pointer; keyboard, menu, and API alternatives exist (file drop needs a file input in the page).
Children stay within their column group when moved.
Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
